data.description:
# Context
Operator-specified (2026-08-12, verbatim): "The 8k cap should be pulling from a config key, defaulting to 8k. When a ticket is saved with a description over the configured cap (create or edit) and the plan review gate is enabled for the project (claim will fail without a passing review), we should display a warning at the time of save to give the client a heads-up that they'll need to edit the description. This provides a more immediate feedback loop instead of waiting for someone to try to run plan review."

Background: the plan-review admission guard (landed as 7cf80009d9, "Block oversized ticket descriptions before review") fast-fails reviews on descriptions over a hardcoded ~8,000-char limit. Tonight FOUR separate agents hit it blind at review time (fixable at 8,001; mammoth at 8,001; tigermoth's close at 8,180; the pony epic found three children at 11k-22k) — the late feedback loop is measured waste.

# Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 — The admission cap reads from a config key (e.g. under [tool.rebar] plan-review section; exact key name per existing config conventions in docs/config.md), defaulting to 8000; the review guard and the new save-time warning read the SAME key (single source).
- [ ] AC2 — On `create` and `edit` (all three surfaces where description writes happen: CLI, library, MCP), when the saved description exceeds the configured cap AND the plan-review claim gate is enabled for the project, a warning is emitted at save time stating the length, the cap, and that claim will require a passing review which will refuse admission until the description is shortened. The save still succeeds (warning, not rejection).
- [ ] AC3 — No warning when the gate is disabled, or when the description is within the cap; the warning never blocks or alters the write.
- [ ] AC4 — Tests cover: over-cap+gate-on warns (create and edit, each surface's channel — CLI stderr, library logger, MCP result field per established patterns like push_status); over-cap+gate-off silent; under-cap silent; config key respected and default correct.
- [ ] AC5 — docs/config.md documents the key; env-registry/generated docs regenerated if touched; make lint/typecheck pass.
data.title: Config-driven description cap with save-time warning
